meta.name: gnomad-variants
meta.description: Query gnomAD (Genome Aggregation Database) for population allele frequencies, gene constraint scores, and variant annotations to interpret ENCODE regulatory variants. Use when the user needs allele frequencies for variants in ENCODE regulatory elements, wants to assess gene constraint (pLI, LOEUF) for ENCODE target genes, needs population-specific frequencies for GWAS variants overlapping cCREs, wants to filter variants by rarity before functional annotation, or is interpreting ENCODE CRISPR/MPRA results in the context of population genetics. Also use when the user mentions gnomAD, allele frequency, pLI, LOEUF, constraint, rare variants, population frequency, ExAC, or variant filtering.

copy.tagline_en: Query population allele frequencies and gene constraint scores
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to interpret population genetics data in ENCODE regulatory elements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询 gnomAD 数据库，获取人群等位基因频率、基因约束分数（pLI、LOEUF）和变异注释，用于解读 ENCODE 调控变异。
howto.when: 当你询问 gnomAD、等位基因频率、基因约束、罕见变异等关键词，或需要为 ENCODE 调控元件中的变异查询人群频率时触发。

say.text: 查一下 BRCA2 基因的 LOEUF 约束分数。
这个变异 1-55517991-C-CAT 在 gnomAD 中的频率是多少？
say.note: 返回该变异的等位基因频率。

say.text: 帮我过滤出 ENCODE 峰中频率低于 1% 的罕见变异。
say.note: 返回过滤后的变异列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the gnomAD database for population allele frequencies, gene constraint scores (pLI, LOEUF), and variant annotations to interpret ENCODE regulatory variants.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention gnomAD, allele frequency, gene constraint, rare variants, or need population frequencies for ENCODE regulatory variants.

say_en.text: Check the LOEUF constraint score for BRCA2.
What is the frequency of variant 1-55517991-C-CAT in gnomAD?

say_en.text: Filter variants in ENCODE peaks with frequency below 1%.
